import numpy as np

def power_iteration(A, max_iter=1000, tol=1e-10):
    n = A.shape[0]
    v = np.random.randn(n)
    v = v / np.linalg.norm(v)
    eigenvalue = 0
    
    for i in range(max_iter):
        Av = A @ v
        new_eigenvalue = v @ Av
        v = Av / np.linalg.norm(Av)
        
        if abs(new_eigenvalue - eigenvalue) < tol:
            break
        eigenvalue = new_eigenvalue
    
    return eigenvalue, v

def inverse_iteration(A, mu, max_iter=1000, tol=1e-10):
    n = A.shape[0]
    v = np.random.randn(n)
    v = v / np.linalg.norm(v)
    A_shifted = A - mu * np.eye(n)
    
    for i in range(max_iter):
        w = np.linalg.solve(A_shifted, v)
        v_new = w / np.linalg.norm(w)
        eigenvalue = v_new @ A @ v_new
        
        if np.linalg.norm(v_new - v) < tol:
            break
        v = v_new
    
    return eigenvalue, v

def qr_algorithm(A, max_iter=1000, tol=1e-10):
    n = A.shape[0]
    Ak = A.copy().astype(float)
    
    for i in range(max_iter):
        Q, R = np.linalg.qr(Ak)
        Ak = R @ Q
        
        off_diag = np.sum(np.abs(np.tril(Ak, -1)))
        if off_diag < tol:
            break
    
    return np.diag(Ak)

A = np.array([[4, 1, 0], [1, 3, 1], [0, 1, 2]], dtype=float)
eigenval, eigenvec = power_iteration(A)
print(f"Dominant eigenvalue: {eigenval:.6f}")
print(f"Eigenvector: {eigenvec}")
print(f"Verification: {A @ eigenvec} vs {eigenval * eigenvec}")
